chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Do not eat in vessels of silver, nor in silver-coated vessels.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on eating in silver dishes according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) prohibits eating in silver vessels, a ruling often interpreted by Shia jurists as either a strict prohibition (nahy an al-tahrim) or a strong recommendation for avoidance (nahy an al-karahah) to distinguish Muslims from non-Muslims and prevent extravagance. This tradition is foundational in the chapter on dining etiquette within al-Kafi, highlighting the spiritual and social dimensions of material use in Shia fiqh. The prohibition extends to vessels plated with silver, emphasizing the purity of intent in daily acts of worship.
